description:
Who we are:

Open-minded intellectuals who embrace emerging technologies on our mission to create innovative Software Engineering Solutions that will impact millions of users around the world.


We are looking for:


Join us in building the future of engineering productivity. We're creating a ground-breaking agent garden that will transform how 40,000+ engineers work—enabling seamless connections between AI systems, engineering tools, and data while fostering a thriving marketplace of AI agents and services.


Very good match: Senior BI Engineer, experienced in Looker/Looker Studio, Power BI, GCP digital platforms and databases, architectures and technologies, data modelling & data warehouse, micro-services.


What you will do:


  • Understand the functional aspects of the delivery by constructively discussing with the Product Owner and the Proxy Product Owner.
  • Create and maintain dashboards and reporting layers in Looker/Looker Studio or another data visualization tool.
  • Create technical specifications related to the dashboards and KPI calculations.
  • Support product and business teams with ad-hoc analysis and data-driven recommendations
  • Contribute to data modelling and mapping to ensure data integrity and quality
  • Contribute to data strategy and governance initiatives to improve overall data maturity.


What you must have:


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Data Analyst, BI Engineer, or similar role in a tech-driven environment.
  • Strong experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker), preferably Looker Studio or at least a minimal experience with it.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, Azure), and GCP is highly desirable.
  • Proficiency in SQL and NoSQL.
  • Experience with Python, R, or other statistical tools is a plus.
  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Good communication and relationship with the stakeholders and team members
  • Agile mindset & practices


What's in it for you:


  • Extended compensation and benefits package.
  • Continuous learning opportunities to enhance your professional and soft skills.
  • A great working environment with people who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do and understand the importance of team spirit.


We really welcome open-minded and committed people:


  • Eager to take on new challenges and learn new things;
  • Who put their heart, mind, and soul into everything they do;
  • Who enjoy sharing knowledge and understand the importance of team spirit.


***Only eligible candidates will be contacted to move forward in the recruitment process.
